title: Google Sitemap Generator
text:
## Google Sitemap Generator
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000682659

## Overview
The Google Sitemap Generator add-on greatly improves the directory website’s SEO by creating XML sitemaps. These sitemaps help search engines like Google and Bing better index all of the pages that make up the membership website.
NOTE: Keep in mind that submitting your sitemap to the Google Console doesn't ensure that all pages will get indexed by Google. This article explains more about this: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/sitemaps/overview
Not all pages in a sitemap have value to Google. Learn more about thin pages here: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/advanced/guidelines/thin-content
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually: Google Sitemap Generator Add-On

## Enabling the Add-On

## Create Sitemap File
Login to the Admin area of the site for the Sitemap Generator settings.
Navigate to Toolbox » Sitemap Generator
Click on the " Generate Sitemap " button:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185610183/original/iMap_s5geJbqqjN-k1DTPmWjrK3e5Iot5Q.png?1790104733 | alt: Generate Sitemap button in the Sitemap Generator Tool]
The admin will see a message that a sitemap is being generated.  Depending on the size of the site and how many members it might have, this could take anywhere from a few seconds to a few minutes to complete.  Please do not navigate away from this page while it is processing.
Once it is complete, the admin will see a success message.  Click on "Close Window":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185610184/original/2JNpZN-tFZLAMt7yJrM28RmiOUEHRHP8ng.png?1790104735 | alt: Sitemap Created success message with the Close Window button]
The admin will now see a link for the XML sitemap that they can submit to search engines.  They can copy this link directly or click on the "Copy to Clipboard" button to copy the link to the clipboard:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185610186/original/81TOCRTRGyJLTMtwVU07zmiAkEG-HApj0Q.png?1790104738 | alt: Sitemap link to submit to search engines with the Copy to Clipboard button]
The admin can now create a cron job that automatically updates the sitemap of the site: The admin will have these different options for how often the sitemap is automatically regenerated: every day, every 7 days, or every 30 days:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185610187/original/yJmB9BIc-m35m1x2SpCrgEV-sEgRczXuQg.png?1790104744 | alt: Automatic sitemap update setting]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185610189/original/CzpS4js8rDsHuJGBdiHjZxsUwbosnaZuqg.png?1790104746 | alt: Automatic update options: Never, Every day, Every 7 days, Every 30 days]

## Advanced Sitemap Generation

## How the Sitemap Generator works:

## Exclusions to the Sitemap:
Any Web Page with the "Apply NoIndex, NoFollow" setting checked is not included in the sitemap:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185606766/original/BLXGaabbVUKwLWCJ4k8GnizrzAsKOe79wA.png?1790101863 | alt: Apply NoIndex, NoFollow checked under Advanced Options on the Page Options tab]
If "Add "NOFOLLOW" to Member Web Links?" and "Hide Member Profile from Search Engines?" are set to "YES" within the Membership Plans:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185606772/original/i3zSY_dvnW8IN7HH-FfUO3_18hFTxjn77Q.png?1790101869 | alt: Hide Member Profile from Search Engines and Add NOFOLLOW to Member Web Links set to ON on the Search Visibility tab]
If the Noindex Review & Connect Pages setting is turned on (Settings >> Advanced Settings >> URL Rules tab), the members' write-a-review pages and connect (contact) pages are left out of the sitemap, including pages that use a custom URL for either one. Those pages already tell search engines not to index them, so leaving them out keeps the sitemap limited to pages that can appear in search results.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185606746/original/KdWCz7wbz7X5QbWwDwQc7NRwn-jRMqXb3w.png?1790101857 | alt: Noindex Review and Connect Pages set to ON on the URL Rules tab of Advanced Settings]
The change takes effect the next time the sitemap is generated. In Advanced Controls, the Write a Review and Contact Form SEO Templates are still listed, but with no Sitemap File.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185606776/original/xTuEi5Dj3r7DpunmKwdOd63sJy0W3oeXDQ.png?1790101871 | alt: Are These Members Searchable and Can Unregistered Visitors View These Members settings on the Search Visibility tab]
